discription: A ringing bell-like sound generated with multiple sine waves and a long, decaying envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.01, decay=3, sustain=0, release=0.1, bright=0.5, spread=0.005; var sig, env; var overtone1, overtone2; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq); overtone1 = SinOsc.ar(freq * (2.0 + (bright * 0.1))); overtone2 = SinOsc.ar(freq * (3.0 + (bright * 0.2))); sig = sig * 0.7 + overtone1 * 0.4 + overtone2 * 0.2; sig = sig * [1, 1 + spread]; sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
